lifting_plan: Currently hand-authored. Path to observation-derived: (1) instrument target program/framework via eBPF/Frida/tracer; (2) observe actual primitives invoked; (3) derive redefinition from observed sequences. The hand-authored card is a hypothesis to validate.

metadata.note: The 'jump' Collatz map: for even n, strip every factor of 2 in one step, n / 2**v_2(n) (v_2 is the 2-adic valuation, sympy's multiplicity(2, n)); that is the plain map T applied v_2(n) times, so it agrees with the conjecture's orbits, not its single steps. The redefinition is its bit-level form: n & -n is the lowest set bit of n, which is 2**v_2(n). The earlier source form T(n) named an undefined function and was one T step, not the jump.

name: collatz_via_2adic_valuation
